public_claim_boundary: This contract defines public-safe acceptance gates for adding and counting tasks. It is not external review evidence, not private holdout rotation evidence, not hosted execution evidence, and not v1 readiness evidence.
privacy_boundary: Public outputs may include task ids, app names, relative manifest paths, aggregate counts, and structural pass/fail categories. They must not include private manifests, private routes, seeds, oracle body values, raw private evidence, credentials, local absolute paths, or reviewer/private-source details.

evidence: target request coverage for tool-agent runs
no private names or private-source details

vulnerable_tasks: expected_boundary includes at least one victim or required authorization dimension
oracle includes a replayable status or body check
controls include at least one secure denial replay check
positive exploit replay is scorer-owned through oracle or evidence requirements
secure_controls: denial controls include denial replay checks
all_tasks: controls include actor, method, path, and status or body_contains
allowed hosts are local benchmark fixtures

blocked_until_external_inputs.missing_input: real appsec, benchmark/evals, and AI-agent/tooling reviewer responses
strict release evidence and non-allow-incomplete readiness pass
